payload.description:
1. tests/docker/test_helm_scoring_api_templates.py asserts on raw .tpl template source text (string matching against helper definitions). This is brittle: whitespace or refactors break it without behavior changing, and real regressions in rendered output can pass. Refactor to render manifests via `helm template` with representative values permutations and assert on the rendered YAML.

2. The `plexus-worker.apiUrl` helper renders an empty `api-url` into the worker Secret when neither plexus.api.url nor the global graphqlProxy values are configured, deferring the failure to runtime. First confirm whether any worker mode legitimately runs without an API URL; if not, use `required`/`fail` so misconfiguration surfaces at install time.
payload.title: Helm chart hardening: render-based template tests and required api-url
